name: Live Translate
subtitle: Updates for Live Translate
description: Live speech, camera and screen translation for iPhone.

apps.name: Live Translate
apps.subtitle: Translate speech, camera and screen
apps.localizedDescription: Live speech translation with Arabic dialect auto-detect, camera and screenshot translation, a floating window that shows your screen with the words replaced, live captions for audio, a Safari extension, and 29 languages.
apps.versionDescription: Floating window shows text only again (translated + English kept, in reading order). New Text tab to type or paste. Arabic dialect auto-detect (Gulf/UAE, Egyptian, Levantine/Jordan, Iraqi, Maghrebi) with dialect-aware translation. Faster translation. Fixes: the floating window no longer reads its own text back during screen share; crash when no microphone is available; clearer messages.
